newsitem.title: USA: Further Freeport expansion seen cleared.
newsitem.headline: Further Freeport expansion seen cleared.

text.p: Freeport-McMoRan Copper & Gold Inc said Monday Indonesia's Department of Mines and Energy has indicated its approval to allow expansion of mill operations pending successful completion of environmental assessment process.
The company told its annual security analysts' meeting P.T. Freeport Indonesia Co's mill operations could expand up to 300,000 metric tonnes of ore daily under this approval.
The company noted the fourth concentrator mill expansion now underway will result in a capacity of 190,000 to 200,000 tonnes daily.

Freeport said the current expansion will allow it to maximize value from ore reserves in Irian Jaya, Indonesia, within the Grasberg open pit and incorporating new high grade underground ores -- including Kucing Liar, Big Gossan and Grasberg reserves.
RTZ-CRA, which now owns about 12 percent of Freeport Copper's stock, has a 40 percent stake in the current expansion, from 118,000 tonnes daily.
Freeport spokesman Chris Sammons said "We fully expect them to take their 40 percent" in the expansion to 300,000 tonnes daily.
He said the company is not releasing any definitive reserve changes at the analysts' meeting.
The company said exploratory drilling within the Block A contract of work area continues to yield positive results and will favorably impact mine planning and expansion decisions.
In the adjacent Block B area, the Wabu Gold zone, containing a 3.0 to 4.0 million ounce gold resource, continues to be drilled to bring this resource to reserve status.
Specifically, Freeport said, Block A activities at Kucing Liar continue to provide very encouraging results.

Freeport Copper said the activities are confirming the 200-250 million tonne geologic resource of 2.0 percent copper equivalent previously announced on the southeast quadrant of the Grasberg intrusive.

Additional drilling is being conducted from within the Kucing Liar/Lembah Tembaga drift from the Amole adit, and more work will be required to fully evaluate this deep Grasberg potential, the company said.
It also said surface drilling on the northern flank of the Grasberg intrusive is seeking Kucing Liar and "skarn-type" mineralization at the 2,500-2,900 meter elevation.
Freeport said it believes both Kucing Liar and heavy sulfide "skarn-type" mineralization could surround much of the Grasberg intrusive at these depths.

It said drilling is also underway at other Block B targets, including the Pagane porphyry and Minjauh prospects. The Pagane prospect is a geophysical anomaly matching a 500 meter by 500 meter altered intrusive, where surface samples exhibit anomalous copper and gold mineralization having values ranging from 1.0-2.6 percent copper and 0.75-2.0 grams per ton of gold.

Pagane and another resistivity anomaly also on the north side of Wabu Ridge are thought to be the potential source of the mineralizing solutions which are responsible for the gold resource discovered to date along Wabu Ridge, Freeport said.
It said exploration drilling activities have started on the Pagane and Minjauh prospects.

The company said drilling continues in P.T. Irja Eastern Mineral Corp's Etna Bay District, involving porphyry copper/gold and gold targets, while regional follow-up mapping and sampling continues on other targets within Block I.
Coincident magnetic, geochemistry and geology anomalies are being reevaluated in light of newly acquired geophysical resistivity data, it said.

In Block II, activities are concentrated on completing the regional geology and drilling at the Haiura prospect. Porphyry style mineralization also exists in the Haiura area, where grades from surface samples exhibiting anomalous copper and gold mineralization range between 1.0-1.25 percent copper and 0.75-2.5 grams per tonne gold.

Surface work at Katehawa East, also in Block II, has outlined a 200 meter by 500 meter mineralized intrusive associated with a magnetic high, with surface samples exhibiting anomalous copper and gold mineralization ranging between 1.0-4.5 percent copper and 0.75-4.0 grams per tonne.
A helicopter-assisted sampling program was completed in Eastern Mining's Block III area, with results presently being interpreted, it said.
((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
